in_sanskrit.name: भग्यश्री
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is blessed with good fortune, prosperity, or blessings.

in_hindi.name: भग्यश्री
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is blessed with a lot of success and auspiciousness.

in_tamil.name: பக்யஷ்ரீ
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is blessed with great wealth, great fortune, and is prosperous.

in_telugu.name: భగ్యశ్రీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is blessed with great wealth, great prosperity, and is virtuous.

in_marathi.name: Bhagyaashri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagyaashri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Bhagya bestows Fortune and Prosperity upon the devotee.

in_bengali.name: Bhagyaashri
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Fortune, Prosperity
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhagyaashri একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Goddess Bhagya bestows Fortune and Prosperity upon the devotee.

vedic_reference.note: The name Bhagyaashri is derived from the Sanskrit roots भग् (bhag) and श्री (shri), which signify fortune, prosperity, and the Goddess of Fortune, respectively.
